crossRefs.note: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.

translations.web: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.
translations.bsb: 36,000 cattle, including a tribute to the LORD of 72,
translations.kjv: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute was threescore and twelve.
translations.asv: And the oxen were thirty and six thousand; of which Jehovah's tribute was threescore and twelve.
